items.name: Moss Mother
items.how: The first boss, in the upper part of the Ruined Chapel. Cut the two vines blocking the entrance to reach her. Beating her opens the way up out of Moss Grotto.

items.name: Hunter Crest
items.how: The starting Crest; you have it from the beginning. Tick it to use it in the Build picker.

items.name: Silk Spear
items.how: A Silk Skill. Reach Mosshome from The Marrow by heading left past Shakra, the map seller. Climb to its upper part and interact with the idol there to learn it.

items.name: Choral Commandment
items.how: A relic on a ledge on the east side of the shaft above Bone Bottom, behind a breakable wall. Reach it from the west edge of Mosshome.

items.name: Simple Key
items.how: Buy it from Pebb, the merchant in the middle of Bone Bottom, for 500 Rosaries; he sells only one. It opens locked gates, such as the one to Flintslate.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Moss Grotto
items.how: Behind a breakable wall in the mossy rooms above Bone Bottom: from the Mosshome lift go right and break the weak wall in the left corner of the next room. Guides give different routes.

items.name: Druid's Eye
items.how: The Moss Druid's wish, Berry Picking: gather Mossberries from the mossy lowlands and bring them back.
items.effect: Gives Silk when Hornet is hit.

items.name: Shard Pendant
items.how: In a small room west of the tall central chamber.

items.name: Compass
items.how: Sold by Shakra the map seller for 70 Rosaries.

items.name: Quill
items.how: Sold by Shakra the map seller for 50 Rosaries. It draws the rooms you visit onto the maps you bought.

items.name: Mosslands Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra, whom you first meet in The Marrow, for 40 Rosaries. Some guides call it the Bone Bottom Map.

items.name: The Marrow Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra for 50 Rosaries.

items.name: Bench Pins
items.how: A map pin that marks benches. Sold by Shakra for 60 Rosaries.

items.name: Shell Marker
items.how: A map marker you can place yourself. Sold by Shakra for 40 Rosaries.

items.name: Bell Beast
items.how: Trapped in silk at the Bellway. Cut it free with Silk Spear and beat it; the Bellway then works for travel.

items.name: Silk Heart, Bell Beast
items.how: After the win, touch the silk the Bell Beast leaves behind and climb the short challenge of crumbling platforms it opens; the Silk Heart is at the top.

items.name: Straight Pin
items.how: In Grindle's prison cell, in the tall room at the far right near the way to Hunter's March. Free him to reach it.

items.name: Tool Pouch upgrade, Loddle
items.how: Pass Loddle's aiming challenge with the Straight Pin.

items.name: Magnetite Brooch
items.how: Sold in the Bone Bottom shop for 120 Rosaries.

items.name: Memory Locket, Volatile Flintbeetles
items.how: The reward for the Volatile Flintbeetles wish, handed in at the Bone Bottom Wishwall. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Swift Step
items.how: Climb to the top of the Deep Docks and bind the Weaver effigy there. A dash.

items.name: Deep Docks Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra for 50 Rosaries.

items.name: Crafting Kit, Forge Daughter
items.how: Sold by the Forge Daughter for 180 Rosaries.

items.name: Magma Bell
items.how: Sold by the Forge Daughter for 110 Rosaries and a Craftmetal.
items.effect: Less damage from fire and lava.

items.name: Sting Shard
items.how: Sold by the Forge Daughter for 140 Rosaries and a Craftmetal.
items.effect: A trap that hangs in the air.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Deep Docks
items.how: At the end of a platforming challenge near the Forge Daughter.

items.name: Memory Locket, Deep Docks
items.how: At the very bottom of the Deep Docks, left of the big chamber with the diving bell. Break a wall on a ledge and follow the hidden way down to a corpse.

items.name: Lace
items.how: Dash in mid-air to reach the lever near Shakra's room; it opens Lace's arena. Beating her opens the way to Far Fields.

items.name: Mask Shard, Bone Bottom shop
items.how: Sold in the Bone Bottom shop for 300 Rosaries.

items.name: Warding Bell
items.how: At the bottom of the central Far Fields room.
items.effect: A one-hit shield while Hornet binds.

items.name: Far Fields Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra, who waits in a cave in the southwest of Far Fields, for 50 Rosaries.

items.name: Drifter's Cloak
items.how: The Seamstress's wish, Flexile Spines: collect Spine Cores from Hokers and bring them to her. The cloak lets you glide on air currents.

items.name: Weaver Effigy
items.how: A relic in a small room high above Bone Bottom. From the platforms on the east side, above the lever, dash-jump and glide to it.

items.name: Mask Shard, Far Fields
items.how: Above the Seamstress's home; glide up to it.

items.name: Bone Scroll
items.how: A relic east of the Seamstress's home. Ride the tall wind current up, then hit the lava bulb to uncover a corpse that holds it.

items.name: Flintslate
items.how: Behind a locked gate in Deep Docks, on the way towards Far Fields. The gate needs a Simple Key from a merchant.
items.effect: Sets the Needle alight for a few seconds, for more damage and a chance to burn.

items.name: Fourth Chorus
items.how: Blocks the way up once you have the cloak. Beating it opens the air vents up to Pilgrim's Rest and Greymoor.

items.name: Weighted Belt
items.how: Sold at Pilgrim's Rest for 160 Rosaries.
items.effect: Less knockback, both taken and from Hornet's own hits.

items.name: Tool Pouch upgrade, Pilgrim's Rest
items.how: Sold at Pilgrim's Rest for 220 Rosaries.

items.name: Memory Locket, Pilgrim's Rest
items.how: Sold by Mort in Pilgrim's Rest for 150 Rosaries. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Hunter's March Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra. One guide gives 70 Rosaries; nobody else confirms it yet.

items.name: Curveclaw
items.how: Sold by Mottled Skarr for 140 Rosaries.

items.name: Fractured Mask
items.how: Sold by Mottled Skarr for 260 Rosaries.
items.effect: Survives one fatal hit, then breaks; a bench mends it.

items.name: Memory Locket, Hunter's March
items.how: On a corpse just before the Chapel of the Beast. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Savage Beastfly
items.how: In the Chapel of the Beast at the east end of the March, after a short climb.

items.name: Memory Locket, Hunter's March hidden room
items.how: In a hidden room past the chapel boss. Only one description of this spot exists so far.

items.name: Beast Crest
items.how: Bind the great husk in the chapel after the fight.

items.name: Thread Storm
items.how: Win the bird fights in the building at Craw Lake, pull the lever so balloons appear, then pogo up them to the Weaver statue at the top right of Greymoor.

items.name: Greymoor Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra for 70 Rosaries. One guide says 50.

items.name: Reaper Crest
items.how: In the arena of the Chapel of the Reaper.

items.name: Threefold Pin
items.how: In a hidden room above the Craw House; set the bouncing platforms moving to reach it.
items.effect: Throws three pins at once in a spread.

items.name: Memory Locket, Halfway Home
items.how: In a hidden room near Creige at Halfway Home. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Bone Scroll
items.how: A relic east of Halfway Home. Swim along a hidden path, then drop down to a corpse.

items.name: Flea Brew
items.how: Fleamaster Mooshka's wish, The Lost Fleas: once five fleas have joined the Flea Caravan, it moves on and she gives you this.
items.effect: Faster attacks and movement for about ten seconds.

items.name: Moorwing
items.how: Greymoor's last boss, at its far left. Beating it opens the way to Bellhart.

items.name: Memory Locket, Moorwing
items.how: Past the fan to the right of the Moorwing arena. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Mask Shard, Shellwood
items.how: Behind a breakable wall, past a trap of flowers.

items.name: Shellwood Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra. One guide gives 70 Rosaries; nobody else confirms it yet.

items.name: Longpin
items.how: Behind the wasp nest in Shellwood.
items.effect: A heavy pin that pierces shells.

items.name: Pollip Pouch
items.how: Greyroot's wish, Rite of the Pollip: gather Pollip Hearts from the purple flowers of Shellwood.

items.name: Sister Splinter
items.how: Shellwood's boss, reached by the lift to the central bench.

items.name: Cling Grip
items.how: West of Sister Splinter's arena, past a pogo course: bind the Weaver effigy. Lets you cling to and jump off walls.

items.name: Memory Locket, The Marrow
items.how: Through a narrow opening in the northwest of The Marrow, which you climb to with Cling Grip. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Widow
items.how: Climb with Cling Grip to her arena. Beating her lifts Bellhart's curse.

items.name: Bellhart Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra for 40 Rosaries. She only answers the bronze rings in Bellhart after the Widow is beaten.

items.name: Memory Locket, Bellhart
items.how: Sold by Frey in Bellhart for 330 Rosaries once the Widow is beaten. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Needolin
items.how: Given when Bellhart is freed from its curse.

items.name: Sharpened Needle
items.how: Pinmaster Plinney sharpens the Needle for free once the town is freed.

items.name: Crafting Kit, Creige
items.how: Creige's wish, Crawbug Clearing: hunt Crawbugs in Greymoor and bring back their Ragpelt.

items.name: My Missing Courier
items.how: Frey's wish at the Bellhart Wishwall: follow the goods Tipp dropped, starting in lower Shellwood, to find him. Guides disagree on where he ends up; return to the Bellhart shopkeeper after you talk to him.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Bellhart
items.how: Sold by Frey in Bellhart for 270 Rosaries once the courier quest is done.

items.name: Multibinder
items.how: Sold in Bellhart for 880 Rosaries once the courier quest is done.

items.name: Bellhome Key
items.how: Finish the Bellhart donation wishes, then keep talking to Pavo until he has nothing more to say. He gives you the key to the empty bell-house.

items.name: Bellhome Desk
items.how: Furniture for your Bellhome, sold by Frey for 380 Rosaries. Guides disagree on the price (250 and 280 also appear).

items.name: Bellhome Gleamlights
items.how: Furniture for your Bellhome, sold by Frey for 320 Rosaries.

items.name: Bellhome Bell Lacquer
items.how: Furniture for your Bellhome, sold by Frey for 520 Rosaries.

items.name: Bellhome Personal Spa
items.how: Furniture for your Bellhome, sold by Frey for 1100 Rosaries. It only appears after two other furniture purchases; rest elsewhere and come back if it does not show.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Greymoor
items.how: Near the shortcut to Sinner's Road; climb to it with Cling Grip.

items.name: Pimpillo
items.how: In Yarnaby's tower; climb with Cling Grip. Costs a Craftmetal.
items.effect: A bomb that bursts on contact.

items.name: Mask Shard, Deep Docks
items.how: Above the westernmost bench; climb to it with Cling Grip.

items.name: Wanderer Crest
items.how: In the Chapel of the Wanderer at Bonegrave, west of the Ruined Chapel; you fight a few waves of enemies for it. Cling Grip gets you there down the main funnel in Bone Bottom; guides also describe a way in with a Simple Key through the Wormways.

items.name: Mask Shard, Wormways
items.how: Behind a breakable wall in the south of the Wormways.

items.name: Wormways Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra. One guide gives 70 Rosaries; nobody else confirms it yet.

items.name: Dead Bug's Purse
items.how: Near the northern entrance of the Wormways.
items.effect: Keeps some Rosaries when Hornet dies.

items.name: Memory Locket, Wormways
items.how: In the lower left part of the Wormways. It opens one locked Crest slot.

items.name: Barbed Bracelet
items.how: In a pit at the end of the first road.

items.name: Sinner's Road Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra. One guide gives 90 Rosaries; nobody else confirms it yet.

items.name: Tacks
items.how: Crull and Benjin's wish, Roach Guts: hunt the Muckroaches of Sinner's Road and bring back their guts.

items.name: Great Conchflies
items.how: Two burrowing bosses in the northwest of the Blasted Steps, blocking the way to the Pinstress.

items.name: Blasted Steps Map
items.how: Sold by Shakra. One guide gives 70 Rosaries; nobody else confirms it yet.

items.name: Needle Strike
items.how: Talk to the Pinstress in her hut at the far west end and train with her. A charged Needle attack.

items.name: Memory Locket, Blasted Steps
items.how: Pogo across the hanging bells, then drop into a dark passage. Only one guide describes this spot.

items.name: Silkspeed Anklets
items.how: In Weavenest Cindril, which needs the Needolin.

items.name: Spool Fragment, Weavenest Atla
items.how: Through the west exit of the lift shaft.

items.name: Mask Shard, Weavenest Atla
items.how: Through the east exit of the lift shaft.

items.name: Moss Mother duo
items.how: Two Moss Mothers at once, west of the Weavenest Atla bench.

items.name: Weavelight
items.how: Past the two Moss Mothers, west of the bench.
